subtasks.title: Missed Opportunities card at mockup row 3 col 3, plus the MissedOpportunityClientGraph grain fix
subtasks.approach:
Single node, no fan-out. The whole change is one widget family with one query owner, and the two nominal halves total ~35 lines of production code across 4 files; worktree fan-out overhead would dwarf the work. TDD throughout: write the pinning test, confirm RED, then implement to GREEN.

STEP 1 (new widget). Create app/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/MissedOpportunities.php modelled on RecoveryCounts.php (28 lines) -- extends Concerns\DashboardWidget, sets $heading = 'Missed Opportunities', getDatasetLabel(), getRgbColor(), and implements ONLY getModelQueryForDates(), which returns (int) MissedOpportunity::query()->forOrg(auth()->user()->org_id)->notNicb()->between($start, $end, auth()->user()->timezone ?? 'UTC')->selectTotal()->value('total'). Use the model's EXISTING scopes -- do not restate the countDistinct SQL inline, and do not add ->final(). Override canViewCardData() to auth()->check() && (Feature::active(FeatureEnum::MISSED_OPPORTUNITY->slug()) || session()->has('admin_impersonator')) per the operator's Q1 answer, and canView() to parent::canView() && static::canViewCardData() for the direct-mount path. One-line 'why' comment on canViewCardData() only; otherwise minimal comments.

STEP 2 (registry). Insert 'missed-opportunities' => MissedOpportunities::class into CompanyMetricsOverview::cards() BETWEEN 'recovery-counts' and 'recovery-leader'. Do NOT append. Un-bracket [Missed Opportunities] in the mockup docblock table.

STEP 3 (colour). Add 'missed-opportunities' => 'primary' as an explicit arm to DashboardWidget::getStatColor(), before default => 'gray'. Never 'gray'.

STEP 4 (grain fix). In MissedOpportunityClientGraph::clients(): change selectRaw('client_org_name, count() as total') to selectRaw('client_org_name, countDistinct(hotlist_id) as total'), and add a ':v2' version segment to the cache key 'missed-opportunity:client-graph:org=...:tz=...'. Change NOTHING else in that file -- not canView(), not the YTD window.

STEP 5 (fix the two broken test files). DashboardCardExpansionTest: bump the count 7->8 and insert the key into the exact-order assertSame array at the same position. Leave test_all_four_hit_cards_are_contiguous() untouched. DashboardCardVisibilityTest: bump assertCount(7, cards()) -> 8 at :144; update test_every_real_card_is_ungated_and_therefore_expandable() to record this deliberate first gated card (the prior ticket's comment authorises exactly this); and update test_can_view_card_data_is_total_with_no_authenticated_user() to preserve its stated purpose (expandableCards() is callable with no authenticated user and does not error) while relaxing the incidental cards()==expandableCards() key-equality assertion, which no longer holds now that a real gate drops the key via array_filter.

STEP 6 (new tests). Two new files per prep-context.tests.

STEP 7. composer format (Pint).

test_notes: FILTERED runs only during implementation: `php artisan test --filter='DashboardCard|MissedOpportunit'` is fine at the default memory limit.

For the post-merge FULL suite use `php -d memory_limit=2G vendor/bin/phpunit`. NEVER `php artisan test` for the full suite -- it OOMs during discovery and STILL EXITS 0, reporting a false pass. Expect ~1668 tests and ~8 PRE-EXISTING failures; verify any suspected regression by running the class alone and against the base commit before believing it.

This worktree's .env.testing currently has CLICKHOUSE_DRIVER=pgsql, which makes RequiresClickhouse skip EVERY ClickHouse test while reporting all-green. The MissedOpportunityClientGraph grain test is CH-backed, so Phase 4 must bring ClickHouse up (the change touches ch_tables) and the driver must be `clickhouse` with the LITERAL database names clarity and zod -- a per-worktree CH database name silently truncates the wrong database.
Those literal clarity/zod ClickHouse databases are SHARED across worktrees. Teardown must never DROP them.
